# A cost stated on a share purchase, in a transaction with no CAD figure in
# it. A share is a holding with a cost in the book's own currency (Q-046), and
# a transaction written wholly in US dollars states no such figure — the same
# shape a currency arriving in its own currency has. So `cost_basis_cost:`
# says what the units cost, and the cost basis opened for them carries it.
2024-03-06 * "Buy USTECH with a cost stated on it"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Brokerage:USTECH 10 USTECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USTECH"
		share_price: "50"
		value: "500.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "50 CAD/USTECH"
	Assets:USD Cash -500.00 USD
